test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the daughter of B',

A - B means 'A is the husband of B',

A × B means 'A is the brother of B' and

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'.

Based on the above, how is P related to G if 'V ÷ P - F + G × C' ?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Husband
 Brother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: V ÷ P - F + G × C

It means: V is the Father of P, P is the Husband of F, F is the Daughter of G, G is the Brother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/535540babc189f76dcfe8d5775c66c74acaf4812d1452a6b77e09efdfbd869f4.png] 

So, P is the '**Daughter's husband**' of G.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
